svg.text: Blank 250 wide x 367 long from 3 mm 5052 aluminium.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Bend line 165 mm from one end: the short side is the upright leg,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the long side (200 mm) carries the panel. Fold to 135 degrees so

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the legs are 45 degrees apart; a sheet metal shop can do it.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Upright leg: two pairs of 9 mm holes, 42 mm apart across the centre

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: line, 42 and 132 mm below the outside of the bend.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Panel leg: four 5.5 mm holes, 8 mm in from each side edge, 20 and

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 180 mm from the outside of the bend.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: the upright leg sits on two V-saddles on the outer face of the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: mast top, held by two U-bolts; the panel's frame lip sits on the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: panel leg with four M5 bolts, nuts inside the frame.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The panel faces away from the bin, tilted 45 degrees.
